\mathsf{Str}_{\mathsf{Pmu}}

\{(S,P,L):
S\ne\varnothing,\
S\text{ 有限},\

\forall s\in S\ \sum_{t\in S}P(s,t)=1,\
L:S\to\mathcal P(\mathsf{AP})\}.

F_{A,X}^{\mathcal M,\eta}:\mathcal P(S)\to\mathcal P(S),
\qquad
F_{A,X}^{\mathcal M,\eta}(U)
=
\llbracket A\rrbracket_{\mathcal M,\eta[X:=U]}^{\mu}.

\operatorname{MonoBody}_{\mathcal M,\eta}(X,A)
\Longleftrightarrow
\forall U,V\subseteq S\,
\bigl(U\subseteq V\Rightarrow
F_{A,X}^{\mathcal M,\eta}(U)\subseteq F_{A,X}^{\mathcal M,\eta}(V)\bigr).

\bigl(\forall B\in\Gamma\,s\in\llbracket B\rrbracket_{\mathcal M,\eta}^{\mu}\bigr)
\Rightarrow
s\in\llbracket A\rrbracket_{\mathcal M,\eta}^{\mu}.

=
\{(\mathcal M,\eta,s):

s\in S,\
\forall B\in\Gamma\,s\in\llbracket B\rrbracket_{\mathcal M,\eta}^{\mu},\
s\notin\llbracket A\rrbracket_{\mathcal M,\eta}^{\mu}\}.
